tasks.short: Study actual consumer reactions to products, packaging and advertising through surveys and tests.

steps.what: Design actual consumer surveys or tests and define the reaction-coding framework and analysis plan
inputs: actual product, package or advertising study question
actual target sample and research constraints
outputs: human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan

steps.what: Conduct actual consumer surveys or tests and capture authentic responses and data-quality exceptions
inputs: human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan
outputs: authentic captured responses with identifiers and data-quality exceptions

steps.what: Assign proposed codebook themes to actual open responses with supporting source passages
inputs: authentic captured responses with identifiers and data-quality exceptions
human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan
outputs: proposed response codes with exact source passages and unresolved cases

loop.purpose: Propose fixed-codebook themes for authentic consumer open responses
loop.input: actual responses and human-authored codebook from s1/s2
loop.output: proposed codes with exact response passages and explicit unresolved cases
loop.check: In s4 the psychologist checks every coded segment's meaning and omitted themes against the original response; ambiguity remains unresolved rather than forced
loop.stop: Missing source passage, codebook mismatch or two failed revisions routes that response to manual coding
loop.why_not_simpler: Closed responses use fixed mappings; variable open-response meaning needs a bounded code proposal rather than keyword matching

steps.what: Check every proposed coded segment against actual response meaning and resolve ambiguous or omitted themes
inputs: proposed response codes with exact source passages and unresolved cases
authentic captured responses with identifiers and data-quality exceptions
human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan
outputs: human-validated reaction codes and unresolved limitations

steps.what: Calculate specified aggregate response counts and comparison tables from verified study data
inputs: human-validated reaction codes and unresolved limitations
authentic captured responses with identifiers and data-quality exceptions
human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan
outputs: aggregate comparison tables with dataset and parameter lineage

steps.what: Interpret consumer reactions and assess comparison validity, sampling limits and uncertainty
inputs: aggregate comparison tables with dataset and parameter lineage
human-validated reaction codes and unresolved limitations
human-designed survey/test protocol, codebook and analysis plan

steps.what: Write and check the actual product, package or advertising reaction findings
inputs: aggregate comparison tables with dataset and parameter lineage

steps.what: Save the ordinary internal consumer-reaction study record

tasks.design: Use fixed survey mappings and deterministic aggregate tables first, with bounded code proposals only for actual open-response text under the psychologist's codebook. Retain authentic survey/test administration, every-segment meaning checks, scientific interpretation and authored findings; ordinary internal saves are small, ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assigning initial open-response codes and repeatedly compiling agreed comparison tables can consume manual study work.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest documents qualitative code suggestions with human segment checks, while specified table calculations can run deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Authentic response quality, ambiguous themes and comparison validity remain research judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a consumer's apparent approval is ironic, conditional or about another product feature.
tasks.altitude: Validate actual response meaning and study validity rather than assign initial codes and recalculate tables.

evidence.claim: The digest documents MAXQDA suggesting qualitative codes and advising human checking of every AI-coded segment, not measured time savings for this study.
Model knowledge: explicit aggregate tables can be calculated deterministically from verified study data and a human analysis plan.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual survey/test capture application and qualitative coding workspace. Shares20/25/10/10/10/15/9/1 are provisional, not measured. s2 counts authentic fresh response capture and quality exceptions; s1 supplies the actual codebook. No synthetic respondents, free transcripts or inferred consumer profiles are assumed.

s3 counts only actual initial coding work and s5 actual repeated manual table preparation/calculation, not existing model/statistical engine runtime or already automated survey tables. Full segment checking10 remains. Analysis is aggregate study support, not individual targeting, emotion inference or an automatic product recommendation. Only approved research data may enter the code-proposal route; otherwise code manually.
unknowns: How much actual initial open-response coding and table preparation is manual?
research_questions: Compare proposed codes with every original response and test table lineage on an actual study.

incremental.description: Maintain actual codebook constraints and table specifications when stimuli or response structures change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes10 initial-code plus10 repeated-table points less1.3 upkeep. Low: novel packaging language creates ambiguous themes and noncomparable test groups, requiring manual coding and bespoke comparisons for most data; only3 straightforward code-proposal plus2 unchanged aggregate-table points disappear, less1.3 upkeep. Study design20, authentic capture25, every-segment check10, interpretation15, authored findings9 and save1 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain authentic consumer research and interpretation while checking traceable coding and tables.
skills_to_grow: Design codebooks that preserve ambiguous reactions
Validate comparison groups and source lineage
role.ambitious_version: Study real consumer reactions with reproducible support without replacing participants or scientific judgement.
